sourceNotes: 新增默认关闭的实验性应用分身，支持微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 和企业微信
命令栏与启动台自动收录已登记的应用分身，可按分身名或原应用名搜索
修复应用分身创建进度、名称和启动台布局
修复部分设备无法读取 GPU 功耗的问题
清理空间前核验大文件身份，避免误移走被替换的文件

en: Adds experimental app cloning, off by default, for WeChat, QQ, Lark, Telegram, and WeCom. Each clone has separate data and can be launched and managed independently.
The command bar and Launchpad automatically list registered app clones, searchable by clone or original app name.
Fixes clone names, creation progress, and Launchpad layout, and removes leftover build files when deleting a clone.
Fixes missing GPU power readings on some devices by falling back when the dedicated energy channel is unavailable.
Rechecks a large file's identity before moving it to the Trash, preventing an unintended move if the file was replaced.
